Aleph Skill **v2.9.0** upgrades the numerical causal engine, unlocks D Research `3.8.0` execution-evidence and source-grounding routes, promotes `packs/economics` to `calibrated` maturity across 30 empirical hindcasts, expands strategic roleplay with goal-synthesized utility weights and branch exploration, and ships a turn-key end-to-end simulation pipeline orchestrator.

## Highlights

- **Bundled D Research 3.8.0 & unlocked gateway routes.** Pins upstream-attested D Research `v3.8.0` (247 runtime files, SLSA provenance verified) in `component-lock.json` and exposes `research:execution-evidence` and `research:grounding` through `scripts/research_gateway.py` with full workspace-path boundary validation.
- **Equilibrium stock retention, level inertia & tail-shock Monte Carlo (`Formula 2.2.0`).** `scale: "stock"` nodes under `formula_version: "2.2.0"` default to `retention_mode: "baseline"` so unshocked equilibria hold their declared baseline (`"zero"` remains opt-in, while `2.0.0`/`2.1.0` bit-identical replay is untouched). Level nodes accept `inertia` in `[0.0, 1.0)` for damped adjustment, and scenarios can declare deterministic Bernoulli `stochastic_shocks` rules that sample tail events (`tail_class: "tail_shock"`) reproducibly across Monte Carlo runs.
- **Calibrated Economics domain pack (`can_emit_probability: true`).** Removes synthetic placeholder fixtures and validates `packs/economics` against 30 reproducible empirical hindcast cases (`case-001`..`case-030`) with both per-case bounds and portfolio `mean_mae` / `mean_rmse` gates in `scripts/aleph/packs.py`.
- **Cleaner causal induction & turn-key pipeline.** Fixes wide CSV chronological baseline extraction (`vals[0]`) and compacts verbose clause labels in `scripts/aleph/auto_causal.py` while keeping full clause text in `description`. Adds `scripts/run_pipeline.py` (and `npm run sim:pipeline`) to run `init -> import -> propose -> review -> apply --into-initialized -> compile -> simulate -> replay -> validate -> render-report` in one deterministic command.
- **Goal-driven roleplay & branch simulation.** Actors declared with `objectives` automatically synthesize `state_weights` and payoff tables when `utility_table` is omitted, and `scripts/interactive_roleplay.py simulate-branches` explores multi-actor action profiles deterministically without breaking sealed offline execution contracts.

## Upgrade

Choose the [runtime ZIP](https://github.com/d-init-d/aleph-skill/releases/download/v2.9.0/aleph-skill-runtime-v2.9.0.zip) for normal use or the [full ZIP](https://github.com/d-init-d/aleph-skill/releases/download/v2.9.0/aleph-skill-v2.9.0.zip) for development and local release checks. Python 3.10+ and Node.js 18+ are supported.

Install into a fresh directory. Keep a backup of existing workspaces, preserve their declared `formula_version` and `retention_mode` if reproducing legacy runs, and replay or validate before regenerating version-bound receipts. Workspace schema `2.0.0` remains the write default, with schema `2.1.0` opt-in.

From the extracted directory, check the environment and run either the demonstration quant run or the turn-key pipeline self-test:

```sh
python3 scripts/preflight.py --json
python3 scripts/run_pipeline.py --self-test
```

## Verify the download

Put the two ZIPs, `distribution-manifest.json`, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` in one directory. Verify the listed digests and the build provenance before installing:

```sh
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt  # macOS alternative: shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt

gh attestation verify aleph-skill-v2.9.0.zip \
  --repo d-init-d/aleph-skill \
  --signer-workflow d-init-d/aleph-skill/.github/workflows/release.yml \
  --source-ref refs/tags/v2.9.0

gh attestation verify aleph-skill-runtime-v2.9.0.zip \
  --repo d-init-d/aleph-skill \
  --signer-workflow d-init-d/aleph-skill/.github/workflows/release.yml \
  --source-ref refs/tags/v2.9.0
```

GitHub's attestation service verifies the source tag and workflow identity. The [release workflow](https://github.com/d-init-d/aleph-skill/actions/workflows/release.yml) records cross-platform test checks, reproducible archive builds, and SLSA provenance. Offline provisional runs carry `limited` assurance, and only domain packs with passing calibrated gates (currently `packs/economics`) authorize `calibrated_probability`.
